title: A Trip to Osaka
passage:
Dear Traveler,

You have signed up for a day trip to Osaka, Japan. Osaka is a major business center and has had a big influence on Japan's history. We are sorry to say that the JR line that travels in a circle around Osaka is experiencing some problems, so you must use a different path to get to a couple of the places we have arranged for you.

Thank you and have a nice trip.

Justin Harrison
Travel Now

Trip Plan
On this trip, you will get the chance to see all of the important places in Osaka.

Morning
First, we will go to the center of the city to visit Osaka Castle. This is a great place to learn about Japan's past and buy some gifts for your family and friends.

Noon
After visiting the castle, we will take a short ride to Dotonbori. This place offers the best food in Osaka. Here, you can order ramen from a machine and shop for some fashionable clothes.

Night
To end the trip, we will go to Tsutenkaku, a very famous building in Osaka. You can go to the fifth floor to get a view of the city. There are lights on the tower that shine brightly at night.
